adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` the validation flag `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed `safeParse`, but it is never cleared in `onSuccess` (only `setMultiEmailValue([""])` and `setIsOpenDialog(false)`), and it’s also not cleared on `onOpenChange` close (ESC/X) since that only toggles `isOpenDialog`. The only reset path is the Cancel button handler, which explicitly calls `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`. As a result, after a failed validation the error banner can persist while the user edits emails and can reappear when reopening the dialog after a successful add or closing via ESC/X.
